name: Memory Sketch
description: Everyone draws the same famous thing from memory, no references allowed. After a teacher check, the gallery reveals one attempt at a time.
tagline: Pick something everyone is sure they can picture: Winnie the Pooh, a bicycle, a world map. The gap between memory and the real thing is the whole show.

subject.label: What should everyone draw from memory?
subject.helper: Something famous enough that everyone has seen it, tricky enough that nobody remembers it right.
subject.deckHelper: Pick a ready-made subject, or type your own. Anything from your unit works too: a cell diagram, a map region, a historical figure.

drawTimer.label: Drawing time (seconds)
drawTimer.helper: How long students get to draw. Shorter is funnier.

template.name: Memory Sketch: ${subject}
template.description: Draw it from memory, then compare against the whole gallery. Built with the Memory Sketch recipe.

intro.message:
MEMORY SKETCH!

You are about to draw something you have seen a hundred times. From memory only: no searching, no peeking, no asking a neighbor.

Your brain says it knows. Let's find out.

draw.prompt:
Draw from memory: ${subject}

No references! Just what your brain remembers.

check.template: Review the drawings below, then open the gallery. One bad drawing? Hide it from the moderation list. 'Try again' restarts the round for everyone.

gallery.message: The gallery is open: ${subject}, as this class remembers it. As each one lands, artists get the last word.

end.message: That's Memory Sketch! Now look up the real thing and enjoy how wrong everyone was.
